verdict.rationale: Expensify markets a 'corporate travel management solution' claiming trips won't end in a pile of receipts, implying in-platform booking, but the evidence pack contains only a single vague marketing line with no detail on how flight/hotel booking works, whether travel policy rules are enforced at the moment of booking, or any inventory/GDS integration. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual booking flow, proof that travel policy is applied at booking time (not just expense-time), and any independent/hands-on corroboration of the travel product.
